holdout_rule: Every fifth case by id (RT-05, RT-10, RT-15, RT-20, RT-25) is held back. Never tune a prompt against held-back cases.
notes: RT-01 to RT-21 are the original 21 test messages, unchanged and in the same order, so the Router baseline stays comparable with Week 3 (evidence/test-set-2026-10-04.md and evidence/router-expected-routes-2026-10-06.md). RT-22 to RT-25 are new.
Routes are order_status, decline, refund, human_request, out_of_scope. routes lists every acceptable route. A single-label Router passes if its route is in the list.
split_into marks a mixed request. The Router passes the split check if it hands the message to every specialist listed.
Escalation values: none, required. required means the Router or a specialist must end the session with a handoff to a human. Offers of a human are scored in the specialist sets.
tools_forbidden at Router level means no lookup of any kind may happen before the Router has routed or escalated.
{ORD_nnn} is replaced at run time with the full order UUID. {ORD_MISSING} is an order that does not exist.
